sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 1982
ORDINANCE VII OF 1982
PUNJAB ANIMALS SLAUGHTER CONTROL
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1982
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act,
1963
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th May 1992]
No. Legis. 3 (7)/82.‑---The following Ordinance by the
Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.‑--(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of W.P. Act III of 1963

ORDINANCE VII OF 1982
ORDINANCE VII OF 1982
PUNJAB ANIMALS SLAUGHTER CONTROL
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1982
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act,
1963
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th May 1992]
No. Legis. 3 (7)/82.‑---The following Ordinance by the
Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 2 of West Pakistan Act III of 1963.‑In
the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 (West Pakistan Act III of 1963)
in section 2,‑
(a) for clause (e) the following
shall be substituted :‑
"(e) "local
authority" means an urban local council constituted under the Punjab Local
Government Ordinance, 1979 (VI of 1979) or a Canton ment Board established
under the Cantonments Act, 1924 (II of 1924)."
(b) in clause (k) for the words
"Animal Husbandry Department" appear ing in sub‑l clause (v),
the words "Livestock and Dairy Development Department" shall be
substituted; and
(c) in clause (1), for the words
"Animal Husbandry Department" the words "Livestock and Dairy
Development Department" shall be substituted.
